item.title: Version 1.10.0-beta (92)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.10.0-beta

Build 92

  • View options has a Focus points switch.
  • Turn it off to hide the gold box on the grid, the large photo, and scene review.
  • Sharp, Can sharpen, and Cannot sharpen stay on the photo.
